column2: Hire and train a new kitchen hand. We have had three leave in a year and every time it is a scramble.
Run a weekend fundraising open day at the shelter next month.
Someone has reported a security vulnerability in the amount parser, privately, by email. Handle it.
Bring a new region, eu-central-1, into the fleet.
The company is moving office. Change the registered office address.
A new label, Coldharbour, wants to put work through us. Take them on as a customer.
A patient has put in a written complaint about a missed diagnosis. Take it through to a response.
CAL-01882 is down to 140 seeds in store, below the distribution threshold. Regenerate it.
The quarterly hydrographic station data refresh is due. Do it.
The sprayer needs its NSTS test and both operator certificates are up for renewal.
A freedom of information request has come in about the 1974 boundary review papers. Answer it.
